# Voronoi partition
### set up the Voronoi space
```{r build functions}
create_VoronoiDiagram <- function(Hypothesis){
  X = Hypothesis$x
  Y = Hypothesis$y
  dxy  <- deldir(X,Y,rw=c(0,100,0,100))
  tiles <- tile.list(dxy)
  return(tiles)
}

evaluate_OwnershipVariability <- function(A_rating, B_rating, tiles){
  #ownership_ratings: participant rating for A (y) and B (x)'s ownerships
  #voronoi_specifications: a hypothesis with two lists of centroid coords
  i <- which.tile(B_rating, A_rating,tiles)
  return(i)
}

get_Voronoi_freq_CIs <- function(which_df){
  voronoi_freq_CIs <- which_df%>%
    mutate(G1 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G2 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==2 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G3 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==3 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G4 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G5 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==5 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE)
           )
  
  G1_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G1, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G1\nneither A or B owns")
  
  G2_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G2, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G2\nA owns, B doesn't")
  
  G3_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G3, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G3\nunsure")
  
  G4_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G4, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G4\nA doesn't, B owns")
  
  G5_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G5, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G5\nBoth A and B own")
  
  voronoi_freq_CIs <- rbind(G1_CIs, G2_CIs, G3_CIs, G4_CIs, G5_CIs)
  return(voronoi_freq_CIs)
}
```

```{r create Voronoi space}
x_1 = 18.37710
x_3 = 81.62270	
y_1 = 18.37710
y_3 = 81.62270	
H = data.frame(x=c(x_1,x_1,50,x_3,x_3),
        y=c(y_1,y_3,50,y_1,y_3))
chosen_tiles <- create_VoronoiDiagram(H)
    
area1 <- chosen_tiles$pt.1$area
area2 <- chosen_tiles$pt.2$area
area3 <- chosen_tiles$pt.3$area
area4 <- chosen_tiles$pt.4$area
area5 <- chosen_tiles$pt.5$area
```


# Simulation #1 - are people responding randomly?
accidental conditions - 5 of them. For each accidental conditions, a participant would randomly make two choices from 0 to 1, unit .01
```{r accidental trials - 10000 simulation}
set.seed(1) #2nd 1000 simulation
no_simulation = 10000
df_all_sim_raw = data.frame()
df_all_sim_scores = data.frame()

for(current_simulation_no in seq(1,no_simulation,1)){
  # create dataframe
  sim_agent_A = sample(seq(0,1,.01), 5 * 240, replace = TRUE)
  sim_agent_B= sample(seq(0,1,.01), 5 * 240, replace = TRUE)
  trial_condition = rep(c("1 agent,accidental", "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway",
                          "2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway", "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup", 
                          "2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup"),240)
  sim_ids = rep(seq(1,240,1),each=5)
  sim_raw = data.frame(unique_id = sim_ids, trial_condition = trial_condition, A = sim_agent_A, B = sim_agent_B)
  
  # evaluate which voronoi group (voronoi group evaluated from 1-100 rather than 0-1)
  sim_1 = sim_raw%>%
    mutate(A_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "intentional")==TRUE ~ "intentional drop",
                                      str_detect(trial_condition, "no drop")==TRUE ~ "no drop-off",
                                      TRUE ~ "accidental drop"),
           B_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "pickup")==TRUE ~ "intend to own",
                                      str_detect(trial_condition, "walkaway")==TRUE ~ "no intent to own",
                                      TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
           B_knowledge=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "aware")==TRUE ~ "knowledgeable",
                                 str_detect(trial_condition, "ignorant")==TRUE ~ "ignorant",
                                 TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"))%>%
    rowwise()%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A*100,B*100, chosen_tiles),
           which_simulation = current_simulation_no)
  
  # get mentalistic vs. non-mentalistic scores
  sim_toCluster_data_prep1<- sim_1 %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    select(unique_id, trial_condition, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, B_knowledge, which_Voronoi_group)
  
  # mentalistic
  sim_mentalistic_score <- sim_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
    group_by(unique_id)%>%
    summarise(score = sum(which_Voronoi_group==2))%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(score_type = "mentalistic",
           unique_id = as.numeric(unique_id))
  
  # non-mentalistic
  sim_B_intend_to_own_score <- sim_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
    filter(B_intentionality=="intend to own")%>%
    mutate(B_intend_to_own_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ 1,
                                             TRUE ~ 0),
           unique_id = as.numeric(unique_id))%>%
    select(unique_id,B_intend_to_own_score)%>%
    group_by(unique_id)%>%
    summarise(B_intentional_score = sum(B_intend_to_own_score))%>%
    ungroup()
  
  sim_B_no_intent_to_own_score <- sim_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
    filter(B_intentionality=="no intent to own" | is.na(B_intentionality)==TRUE | B_intentionality=="Not Applicable")%>% 
    mutate(B_no_intent_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ 1,
                                         TRUE ~ 0),
           unique_id = as.numeric(unique_id))%>%
    select(unique_id,B_no_intent_score)%>%
    group_by(unique_id)%>%
    summarise(B_unintentional_score = sum(B_no_intent_score))%>%
    ungroup()
  
  sim_non_mentalistic_score <- sim_B_intend_to_own_score%>%
    left_join(sim_B_no_intent_to_own_score)%>%
    mutate(score=B_intentional_score + B_unintentional_score)%>%
    select(unique_id,score)%>%
    mutate(score_type = "non-mentalistic")
  
  sim_subj_theory_score_long <- sim_mentalistic_score%>%rbind(sim_non_mentalistic_score)
  
  sim_subj_theory_score_wide <- sim_subj_theory_score_long%>%
    spread(score_type,score)%>%mutate(which_simulation = current_simulation_no)
  
  sim_quantify_subj_theory2 <- sim_subj_theory_score_wide%>%
    mutate(which_theory = case_when(mentalistic>`non-mentalistic` ~ "mentalistic theory",
                                    mentalistic<`non-mentalistic` ~ "non-mentalistic theory",
                                    TRUE ~ "uncertain"),
           mentalistic_freq = mentalistic/5,
           nonmentalistic_freq = `non-mentalistic`/5)
  
  df_all_sim_raw <- df_all_sim_raw%>%rbind(sim_1)
  df_all_sim_scores <- df_all_sim_scores%>%rbind(sim_quantify_subj_theory2)
  
  print(current_simulation_no)
  
} 
```

```{r compute mentalistic and physical possession scores}
  # get mentalistic vs. non-mentalistic scores
sim_toCluster_data_prep1<- df_all_sim1_raw %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(which_simulation,unique_id, trial_condition, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, B_knowledge, which_Voronoi_group)

# mentalistic
sim_mentalistic_score <- sim_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  group_by(which_simulation,unique_id)%>%
  summarise(score = sum(which_Voronoi_group==2))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(score_type = "mentalistic",
         unique_id = as.numeric(unique_id))

# non-mentalistic
sim_B_intend_to_own_score <- sim_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  filter(B_intentionality=="intend to own")%>%
  mutate(B_intend_to_own_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ 1,
                                           TRUE ~ 0),
         unique_id = as.numeric(unique_id))%>%
  select(which_simulation,unique_id,B_intend_to_own_score)%>%
  group_by(which_simulation,unique_id)%>%
  summarise(B_intentional_score = sum(B_intend_to_own_score))%>%
  ungroup()

sim_B_no_intent_to_own_score <- sim_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  filter(B_intentionality=="no intent to own"  | B_intentionality=="Not Applicable")%>%
  mutate(B_no_intent_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ 1,
                                           TRUE ~ 0),
         unique_id = as.numeric(unique_id))%>%
  select(which_simulation,unique_id,B_no_intent_score)%>%
  group_by(which_simulation,unique_id)%>%
  summarise(B_unintentional_score = sum(B_no_intent_score))%>%
  ungroup()

sim_non_mentalistic_score <- sim_B_intend_to_own_score%>%
  left_join(sim_B_no_intent_to_own_score)%>%
  mutate(score=B_intentional_score + B_unintentional_score)%>%
  select(which_simulation,unique_id,score)%>%
  mutate(score_type = "non-mentalistic")

sim_subj_theory_score_long <- sim_mentalistic_score%>%rbind(sim_non_mentalistic_score)
  
sim_subj_theory_score_wide <- sim_subj_theory_score_long%>%
    spread(score_type,score)
  
sim_quantify_subj_theory2 <- sim_subj_theory_score_wide%>%
    mutate(which_theory = case_when(mentalistic>`non-mentalistic` ~ "mentalistic theory",
                                    mentalistic<`non-mentalistic` ~ "non-mentalistic theory",
                                    TRUE ~ "uncertain"),
           mentalistic_freq = mentalistic/5,
           nonmentalistic_freq = `non-mentalistic`/5)

df_all_sim1_scores <- sim_quantify_subj_theory2%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(freq_combination = paste(mentalistic_freq,"-",nonmentalistic_freq))
```
